scheme_name: Mahila Samiriddhi Yojana for Minority Community
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Applicant must belong to a Minority Community (Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, or Jains)
Applicant must have relevant educational, technical, or vocational qualifications/experience
Applicant must possess a Pariwar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to ₹1,00,000 per beneficiary to women entrepreneurs, either directly or through Self‑Help Groups.
